summary: Re-verified only the Signer Portal Link fixes and one end-to-end happy-path regression. All 9 scoped backend pytest cases passed, including concurrent atomic submission, and the complete browser flow passed through personalized sharing, public submission, Ready status, and Journal prefill.
seed_data_creation: Created and deleted temporary TEST_ intakes for lifecycle, validation, concurrent submission, and UI regression testing. No test intake or journal entry remains.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 3 confirms all requested feature fixes through the public URL. Completed public GET exposes exactly the seven approved fields; malformed IDs are 400; missing mark-used is 404; blank required fields are 422; exactly one of two concurrent submissions succeeds and later attempts cannot overwrite; create/list include Matthew Yurksaitis; personalized SMS and Ready-to-Journal prefill pass in Playwright. Out-of-scope mobile, rate-limit, and CORS concerns were intentionally not retested.
rca_of_the_issue: The prior feature defects are resolved by an explicit public-response allowlist, centralized ObjectId validation, matched_count handling, Pydantic minimum-length constraints, notary-name serialization, and an atomic find_one_and_update filtered to pending and unexpired intakes. Concurrent and sequential overwrite attempts now return 400 with the original submitted data preserved.
